response.sql: WITH funding_counts AS (SELECT p.fundflux AS funding_source, COUNT(*) AS qc_records FROM scanqc AS q JOIN projects AS p ON p.arcregistry = q.arcref GROUP BY p.fundflux) SELECT funding_source, qc_records, 1.0 * qc_records / SUM(qc_records) OVER () AS fraction_of_total, 1.0 * qc_records / AVG(qc_records) OVER () AS ratio_to_average FROM funding_counts
